title: Regine Velasquez receives standing ovations on opening night of sold-out 'Finale' concert
summary: Asia’s Songbird Regine Velasquez-Alcasid received multiple standing ovations on the opening night of her three-night sold-out concert, which kicked off on Saturday, October 17.
